answer: Joining requires a dual-asset bond, half token and half stablecoin locked as a slashable bond: identity becomes a paid commitment. An agent caught operating a closed ring of mutual attestors faces proof via analysis of reciprocity in the attestation graph. Conviction means the cut funds top up the mutual insurance pool. An onyx with no bond earns no attestation rights. The network watches every dawn for a second identity on the same funds. Without an inlet of fresh stake, a new identity cannot register.
